advancement.jeg.guide.special.stun.descr: Throw a stun grenade at an enemy and apply its flash effect. Distance and line of sight affect success.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.smoke.desc: Throw a smoke grenade and let it release smoke. Next, use smoke to break a hostile missile lock.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.molotov.de: Throw a Molotov at an enemy and cause actual fire damage. Ignition without damage does not count.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.water_conv: Use a grenade while submerged to convert it into a water bomb. Next, extinguish a fire with it.
Throw a water bomb at a burning entity or fire block and actually extinguish it.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.place_c4.d: Place C4 on a valid surface. Set timed or remote mode before placement; then test the corresponding detonation.
Bind placed C4 to your detonator and successfully detonate it within range. Empty or failed requests do not count.
Damage an enemy with C4 you placed. Credit follows the explosive owner after switching items.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.place_clay: Place a claymore on a valid surface facing an approach. Next, let an enemy enter its trigger zone.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.claymore_e: Cause actual enemy damage with your claymore. Placement alone does not count.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.place_tm62: Place a TM-62 on a valid surface. Heavy entities and vehicles can trigger it; small mobs may not.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.tm62_effec: Damage an enemy using your TM-62. Use an enemy vehicle or a sufficiently heavy hostile target.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.defuse.des: Hold the defuser on a placed explosive within reach and sight until defusing finishes. Interrupting cancels the operation.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.drone_depl: Deploy a drone in clear space. Then bind a monitor before controlling it.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.drone_bind: Use a monitor on a reachable drone to bind it. Binding to a missing drone does not count.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.drone_cont: Activate a bound monitor and successfully enter drone control. The link must satisfy range and availability checks.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.drone_unlo: Remove a loaded payload from the drone and receive the returned item. An empty drone cannot satisfy this.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.drone_pack: Use a crowbar on an accessible drone to recover it. Clear or unload its payload first as required.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.javelin_lo: Aim Javelin at a valid large target with clear sight until lock completes. Ordinary small mobs cannot be locked.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.javelin_di: Select direct mode, lock an enemy ground target and deal actual missile damage. Carry Javelin ammunition.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.javelin_to: Select top-attack mode, lock an enemy and hit it with the guided missile. Leave space for the lofted trajectory.
advancement.jeg.guide.special.igla_hit.d: Lock an eligible airborne enemy with Igla, then deal actual guided missile damage. Ground targets do not satisfy air guidance.
